name: Frimpong Cooling & Electrical
description: Call-first one-page site for an AC and electrical repair company in Accra and Tema: petrol green and safety orange, Bricolage Grotesque headings with Figtree, rounded photo cards. It has an emergency strip, a hero with same-day sticker and visit price, a 'do you cover my area?' checker, six priced service cards, a GH₵ price list with MoMo and cash payment, four steps, home and business care plans, recent jobs, Google reviews, covered areas, FAQ, a quote form with service preselect, date picker and photo upload, open-now hours, a mobile call/WhatsApp/quote bar and an Act 843 privacy notice.
